name: dc-basrahs_edge-coop-rec
description: Desert Combat Basrah's Edge co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only: a DC-made level with DC's own AI data, whose tank search map the viewer decodes 81.5% blocked inside the combat area (the levels census: 4 of 6 Iraqi bots frozen in the viewer's runner).
